title: McGurk effect - Auditory Illusion - BBC Horizon Clip
summary: A two-minute BBC Horizon clip demonstrating the McGurk effect, where what you see of a speaker's mouth changes the sound you hear.
why: Recommended as a quick demo of vision overriding hearing, and cited as an example of perception producing confident wrong answers.

quote.text: Very worth your two minutes if you're not yet familiar with the effect
